name: Turntable Video
description: Records a video of the model turning in a circle: frame rate, resolution, length or turns, tilt and camera height.
customHelp: Only for Custom; an even number
turnsHelp: Over the whole video; a whole number loops seamlessly
elevationHelp: Angle above the turntable: 0° is side-on, 60° is almost top-down
zoomHelp: 1 fits the whole part, larger comes closer
queued: {width}×{height}, {fps} fps, {seconds} s — choose where to save the video
errorResolution: The frame size must be between 160 × 120 and 3840 × 2160.
errorOddSize: Frame width and height must be even.
errorFps: The frame rate must be between 1 and 120.
errorDuration: The length must be between 0.5 s and 10 min.
errorChoice: An unknown option was chosen. Open the form again.
errorFrames: Too many frames: at most 36,000 (10 min at 60 fps).
